body:
Conventional Christianity as the worship of a violent, exclusive God of Supremacy is oblivious to the ways it has created a civilization in the image of its God: violent, hostile to the other, and living by the supremacist’s sword—whether white (over nonwhite), Christian (over non-Christian), Western (over non-Western), hetero-masculine (over female and LGBT), or human (over nonhuman).

 – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016)
